# WO-606: More than 4 addresses, and years for each address, in the wizard and setup file
Status: queued (in-house; schema regeneration by orchestrator)
Vendor: claude
Agent: wizard-packager (Nina Alvarez); setup file: automation-engineer (Theo Park)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Kind: wizard
Severity: MEDIUM
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner real-data test, stage 1 (search only), qa-security 2026-11-11. Private results are kept outside the repo; this WO is PII-free by rule.

## Goal
The owner test profile has 5 past and present addresses; only 4 fit. `setup_config.MAX_ADDRESSES = 4` (`setup_config.py:29,73`), and the wizard hard-codes four rows (`wizard/draft.py:250-252`, `wizard/flows.py:99`). Older users, the target audience, often have more. Brokers list old addresses, and `exposure --old-addresses` picks "the most recent previous address" by `to_year`/`from_year` (`engine/exposure.py` `old_address_url`), but the setup file has no year fields (`SetupAddress`, `setup_config.py:57-62`), so that choice falls back to list order. A ZIP is optional (correct: people often don't remember an old ZIP); keep it optional and say so on screen.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Up to 10 addresses in the wizard (an "add another address" control, not 10 empty rows) and in the setup file; one shared constant.
2. Optional `from_year` / `to_year` per address in the setup file and the wizard ("About when did you live there?" with a year range, both optional, validated 1900..this year, from <= to).
3. Missing ZIP and missing street stay valid; the screen says "Leave blank if you don't remember".
4. `schema/setup-config.schema.json` regenerated by the orchestrator (`tools/gen_schema.py`); docs/examples/setup-config.example.yaml shows a 5-address fake person.
5. Tests: 5- and 10-address setup files import; 11 is refused with a plain message; years round-trip into `Address.from_year/to_year`; old-address search picks the latest by year.
